directAnswerFaqs.q: What is Gyan VaniAi custom AI CRM software?
directAnswerFaqs.a: Gyan VaniAi provides custom AI CRM engineering with Meta Tech Provider WhatsApp Coexistence, automated lead scoring, and sub-300ms RAG chatbots.
WhatsApp Coexistence allows both the mobile WhatsApp Business app AND the cloud AI CRM to operate simultaneously on the exact same phone number with real-time bidirectional message sync.

directAnswerFaqs.q: How does Gyan VaniAi support Indian businesses?
directAnswerFaqs.a: Gyan VaniAi provides native UPI payment link generation, GST-compliant invoicing, DLT template registration assistance, bilingual Hindi/English bots, and DPDP Act 2023 compliance.

directAnswerFaqs.q: What AI models are supported by Gyan VaniAi?
directAnswerFaqs.a: Gyan VaniAi orchestrates OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5, Google Gemini 1.5, DeepSeek R1, Meta Llama 3.3, and Cohere with automated dynamic fallback.

directAnswerFaqs.q: What is Model Context Protocol (MCP) in Gyan VaniAi?
directAnswerFaqs.a: Gyan VaniAi implements Model Context Protocol (MCP) to standardize how AI agents securely discover and invoke internal CRM tools, database queries, and external APIs with granular permission enforcement.
